name: marketing_skills_ai_agents
description: A collection of marketing skills and techniques for Claude Code and AI agents focused on conversion rate optimization (CRO), copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering to enhance AI-driven marketing workflows.

inputs.name: marketing_objective
inputs.description: The specific marketing goal or challenge to address, e.g., improve conversion rates or optimize SEO.

inputs.name: input_text
inputs.description: Textual content such as ads, blog posts, or copy needing optimization or creation.

inputs.name: analytics_data
inputs.description: Data from marketing analytics platforms including user behavior, traffic, and conversion metrics.

inputs.name: seo_keywords
inputs.description: A list of keywords to target or optimize content for SEO purposes.

outputs.name: optimized_content
outputs.description: Revised or newly generated marketing copy optimized for CRO, SEO, or engagement.

outputs.name: marketing_strategy
outputs.description: A structured plan outlining steps and techniques for growth engineering and campaign optimization.

outputs.name: performance_report
outputs.description: Insights and analytics evaluation summarizing campaign or content effectiveness.

patterns: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) analysis and improvement
SEO keyword integration and content optimization
Growth engineering workflows combining multiple marketing disciplines
steps: Define marketing objectives for the campaign or content
Analyze existing data and inputs such as analytics and SEO keywords
Generate or optimize marketing copy using AI agents tailored to objectives
Apply CRO techniques to refine content and user funnels
Evaluate outputs via analytics to measure effectiveness
Iterate strategies and content based on performance insights
use_cases: Automating creation of high-converting marketing copy
Optimizing website or campaign SEO through AI-driven keyword strategies
Generating actionable growth engineering plans for startups
Analyzing marketing analytics data to inform strategy
Implementing AI agents to improve multiple facets of digital marketing workflows

prompt_templates.name: copywriting_optimization
prompt_templates.template: Generate persuasive marketing copy focused on {marketing_objective} using keywords: {seo_keywords}.

prompt_templates.name: seo_content_strategy
prompt_templates.template: Create an SEO content strategy targeting these keywords: {seo_keywords} with a focus on {marketing_objective}.

prompt_templates.name: analytics_insights
prompt_templates.template: Analyze the following marketing analytics data and provide a performance report: {analytics_data}.

prompt_templates.name: growth_plan_generation
prompt_templates.template: Develop a growth engineering plan to achieve: {marketing_objective} based on input data and best practices.
